title: Careers
description: Build your career with N S Lootah Group: opportunities across automotive, trading, food, EV charging and natural stone in the UAE.

hero.label: Careers
hero.lede: A family enterprise with a long view, with companies across automotive, trading, food, EV charging and natural stone, and room for people who want to build something lasting.
hero.imageAlt: Colleagues reviewing plans together in a bright Dubai office

why.label: Why join us
why.lede: Our people are the foundation of our success. We empower talent, encourage collaboration and create opportunities to grow.
benefits: A culture rooted in integrity, respect and collaboration
Diverse, meaningful work across the Group’s companies and sectors
Continuous learning and clear paths for career growth
Exposure to local and international business operations
A supportive team driven by innovation and excellence

culture.label: Our culture
culture.text: Each company has its own expertise and commercial focus, but every team works to the same standards: the values that have guided the Lootah family enterprise for generations.
culture.photoAlt: Guests greeting one another at an N S Lootah Group gathering

apply.label: Submit your CV
apply.text: Send your CV with a short note about the role or company that interests you. We keep every application on file and will be in touch when your profile matches an opening.
apply.subject: CV submission
